introHtml: Custom with zipper seat cushions offer a practical advantage for bulk buyers: removable covers that are easy to clean or replace. Whether you're outfitting an office with ergonomic support or branding event seating, the zipper closure ensures a snug fit and long-lasting use. Choose from foam or gel filling, and decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that stands up to daily wear.
